paragraphs.name: Situation
paragraphs.plain: What Claude Code's best-practices doctrine is, why the Command opened a BOLO on it, and how the four clarifying questions got answered.

strand.last: Before 9/17, Claude Code's best-practices doctrine — the four-step workflow: explore, plan, implement, commit — had never been checked against the Command's own SOP, skills, and hooks.
strand.plan: Read the groups below — the transmission from 9/17 and 9/23, what already exists in the Command, and what the record (STATE.md and the session notes) shows — then Execution for what's running now.

groups.label: The transmission, verbatim where Chief ruled

items.t: **9/17:** Chief, reading Claude Code's best-practices page: "a lot of this stuff we should start implementing … the four-step one: explore, plan, implement, commit … should be integrated seamlessly with the documentation we have."

**9/17:** Chief's ask: research first, explore before anything is built; the four steps can be coded in Marine terms; the GitHub field of workflow / MD-storage / documentation repos is a second source Chief is reading too; the adoption itself is "a whole new process of iterative implementation … an agent group."
**9/23:** Chief, ruling all four clarifying questions at once: "all recommendeds are good. Do it."
Two hooks run today: SessionStart (the digest) and Stop (autocommit).

The standing audit function already lives at BOLO 51; the standards campaign at BOLO 50; the life-cycle question (the boresight → how-copy → build → FRAGO loop as a development standard) is tabled at BOLO 53; the reviewer-at-the-fan-in role is RANGE, built under BOLO 54.
STATE.md Blocked #20 held the four clarifying questions at the top of the list from 9/17 ("put these four questions at the top for next session") until Chief ruled them 9/23.

The four questions themselves, verbatim from STATE.md: (1) enforcement or vocabulary — hard hook gates on the four steps, or the named shape of what the Command already does? (2) which docs first — the best-practices page alone, or the whole workflow set (hooks · subagents · plan mode · worktrees · memory)? (3) where it lands — a new SOP section, or folded into BOLO 51's standing audit so there is one department? (4) the NASA layer (BOLO 65) — replace it, or keep it and add Space Force on top? All four ruled 9/23 on the recommendations: vocabulary first · the whole set · fold into BOLO 51 · keep NASA.
The 9/17-6 session note: BOLOs 64–66 captured research only, nothing implemented, nothing re-run; the four questions on BOLO 64 set as the top of the list for the next session.
The 9/17-7 session note: nothing new ruled on BOLO 64; Blocked #20 (the four questions) still carried above the leverage line.
The 9/20-2 session note: a sit rep reviewer caught BOLO 64 unplaced in Block IV of the board; fixed by hand.

strand.last: Chief read the Claude Code best-practices page on 9/17 and said the four steps should be integrated with the documentation we have. Four clarifying questions were asked the same turn and sat at the top of Block V for five sessions.
strand.plan: Answer the four, then read the docs against SOP §1 to §7 and the six skills, one gap table, before anything is built.
strand.you: You ruled all four on the recommendations on 9/23 and said do it. The boresight fired the same turn.
strand.next: Read the gap table on BORESIGHT 64, then rule the top fixes and the hook-gate question with one word each.

**Ruled** — 9/23, Chief: "all recommendeds are good. Do it." All four questions answered on the recommendations: (1) vocabulary first — the four steps named in SOP §1 and every skill header, no hook gates until the boresight shows a step the Command skips; (2) the whole workflow set in one pass — best practices · hooks · subagents · plan mode · worktrees · memory; (3) folded into BOLO 51's standing audit, no new SOP section; (4) keep the NASA layer, no Space Force (BOLO 65 stands).

**Outputs landed** — BORESIGHT 64 (the gap table, 83 rows) and this DOPE SHEET 64, 9/23 03:05.
**The four calls** — gates · fixes · the audit rows · the wording. On the sheet, waiting on one word each.
**The fold** — the four steps written into SOP §1 and the six skill headers; the GAP and PARTIAL rows handed to BOLO 51's audit. Fires on Call 4 and Call 3.
